name: geo_centroid_sum_sq_dist
statement: {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b c : V) : ‖a - (1 / 3 : ℝ) • (a + b + c)‖ ^ 2 + ‖b - (1 / 3 : ℝ) • (a + b + c)‖ ^ 2 + ‖c - (1 / 3 : ℝ) • (a + b + c)‖ ^ 2 = (‖a - b‖ ^ 2 + ‖b - c‖ ^ 2 + ‖c - a‖ ^ 2) / 3
closed: ∀ {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b c : V), ‖a - (1 / 3 : ℝ) • (a + b + c)‖ ^ 2 + ‖b - (1 / 3 : ℝ) • (a + b + c)‖ ^ 2 + ‖c - (1 / 3 : ℝ) • (a + b + c)‖ ^ 2 = (‖a - b‖ ^ 2 + ‖b - c‖ ^ 2 + ‖c - a‖ ^ 2) / 3
informal: For the centroid g of triangle abc, |ag|² + |bg|² + |cg|² = (|ab|² + |bc|² + |ca|²)/3 — a − g = ((a−b) + (a−c))/3 etc., expand all squared norms into inner products.
type: ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b c : V), ‖a - (1 / 3) • (a + b + c)‖ ^ 2 + ‖b - (1 / 3) • (a + b + c)‖ ^ 2 + ‖c - (1 / 3) • (a + b + c)‖ ^ 2 = (‖a - b‖ ^ 2 + ‖b - c‖ ^ 2 + ‖c - a‖ ^ 2) / 3
